notes: Company: BlueBracket Labs — VS Code-first developer tooling startup building an
in-editor copilot for enterprise engineering teams (focus: TypeScript, Go, infra-as-code).
Decision makers: CTO (Asha Mehta) + Head of Platform (Jon Park). Procurement run: security-first.
Initial ask: low-latency streaming completions (sub-50ms local suggestion latency) and line-insert inline suggestions synced to cursor.
Key constraints: per-developer rate limits, token/account quotas for hosted service, ability to pin model versions per-organization and per-repo.
Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs for code prompts & completions, KMS integration for any customer secrets, data residency in US/EU for large enterprise customers.
Architecture preference: hybrid — hosted API for most customers, dedicated pools for enterprise customers, and an optional on-device/local inference fallback for offline devs.
Quote from CTO: 'We need streaming like a keystroke-level feel; 100ms is too slow for muscle-memory. Also no surprises re: source code leaving org without retention controls.'
POC plan: 3-week, VS Code extension integration test -> measure median suggestion latency, token cost per active dev, and inline suggestion accuracy on internal corp repo.
POC success metrics: median RTT <= 80ms for short completions, cold start < 150ms, 5% or less hallucination rate on unit-test prompts, monthly token cost <$700/dev for avg usage profile.
